_comment: __text baseline for the binary-size CI gate (see devkit bench size check and .github/workflows/binary_size.yml). Only AOT gates are recorded: the runtime-lane gates (Gates.RUNTIME in devkit/footprint.py) are not held to a floor and are built only by `devkit bench size compare --runtime`. Measured osx-arm64, 2026-10-06, on mojo 1.2.0.dev2026092105. Regenerate after an intentional size change with: pixi run -e dev python -m devkit bench size check --update. Re-recorded for Parquet's page encodings moving into marrow.codecs: query_cli +16,832 (+0.51%), the hybrid and DELTA_BINARY_PACKED decoders' bounds checks, the dictionary gather's index check, and the reader's corrupt-page checks and bounds-checked views, each copied into every value type's reader; the other gates +2,688 to +4,096 (at most +0.21%), byte order and the bit kernels moving into marrow.codecs. Deltas are against the parent commit's recorded floors, same machine and mojo.
